text:
maria.docs: Heads-up: PR #4821 (release notes + model-catalog deprecations) is ready for review. Need approvals and to lock a merge window so it lands before the Dedicated capacity switchover. Preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood/preview/4821 — CI preview shows 3/4 checks passing, docs-preview failing with linkcheck. cc @devin.platform @raj.ml @kelsey

devin.platform: On it. Can you paste the linkcheck failure? I can try to patch the doc redirects if it's a routing issue.

ci-bot: docsmith:linkcheck FAILED at /docs/models/v1-deprecation -> 404 (referenced from release_notes/2026-03-21.md)

kelsey: I saw that — the anchor in the model catalog changed when we normalized slugs. I'll add a redirect and update the anchor in the release notes. Also planning to add a short migration blurb for embeddings. Who's owning the actual code snippet?

raj.ml: I can write the migration snippet for the embeddings param change (old: embedding_param -> new: embed_api). Will push a small commit to the PR today.

maria.docs: Perfect. We also need a 1-line callout for the top of the release notes: "Model-XYZ v1 deprecated — use model-xyz-quantized or pin older model versions; see migration notes." Can someone craft the exact wording? Audience: product + Dedicated customers.

kelsey: Draft: "Model-XYZ: v1 is deprecated. Upgrade to model-xyz-quantized or pin v1 until you complete migration. See migration guide below for code examples and known behavioral differences." I'll add that under the 'callouts' section and link to raj's snippet when available.

devin.platform: CI also flagged missing frontmatter in release_notes/2026-03-21.md — missing release_date. I'll add release_date: 2026-03-22 and rerun.

ci-bot: docsmith:build RERUN -> linkcheck PASS, static lint PASS, docs-preview BUILD PASSED (deploy id: preview-4821-20260321)

maria.docs: Great, thank you. We need 2 approvals for the docs repo policy. Assigning @kelsey and @raj as reviewers. Plan: if approvals in the next 12h, I will merge tomorrow at 17:00 UTC (to be before the Dedicated switchover). Any objections?

kelsey: Approved. Also updated the model-catalog slug redirect (docs: redirect from /models/v1-deprecation -> /models/model-xyz/v2-notes).

raj.ml: Approved and pushed migration snippet in the PR (files changed: docs/migrations/embeddings.md). Quick note in the snippet about changes in tokenization affecting small differences in cosine similarity.

devin.platform: Suggest waiting one more hour for marketplace indexing to propagate, otherwise downstream customers might see transient 404s. Otherwise LGTM.

maria.docs: Sounds reasonable. I'll hold the merge until 18:00 UTC to give buffer. If no regressions, I'll do the merge and then cut the changelog entry.

kelsey: Also reminder: update the Python SDK snippet in the examples block — param name changed. I'll open a follow-up PR if you want me to handle it after this merges.

maria.docs: Yes please. Open follow-up PR and link it from the changelog so customers have immediate examples.

raj.ml: Small follow-up question — do we want to add a fallback policy snippet for Dedicated customers who can't migrate immediately? I can add a short config sample to the rollout docs.

maria.docs: Good idea. Add that to the Dedicated runbook section in the PR and mention in the release notes under 'Operational notes'.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: preview-4821 validated, no further blockers.

maria.docs: Thanks everyone — merging planned at 18:00 UTC if no issues. Will ping here when done. :thumbsup:
